criteria.label: Expertise & Track Record
criteria.description: Proven expertise with documented results in specific domain
riskIndicators: No prior client work in this area
Can't point to measurable results delivered
Competing against firms with more experience
fixSuggestions: Document 3 specific results from past work

criteria.label: Problem Value
criteria.description: The problem you solve has significant financial impact for clients
fixSuggestions: Quantify the cost of the problem for clients
Focus on revenue-generating or cost-saving outcomes
Target companies in active pain (hiring, scaling, crisis)

criteria.label: Market Access
criteria.description: Ability to reach and close decision-makers
riskIndicators: No existing network in target industry
fixSuggestions: Leverage existing network for warm intros
Create content that attracts inbound leads

criteria.label: Delivery Model
criteria.description: Scalable way to deliver value without burning out

criteria.label: Pricing & Positioning
fixSuggestions: Target clients who value expertise over price

failurePatterns.description: Trying to serve everyone results in serving no one well
All delivery depends on founder, limiting growth
No consistent pipeline leads to revenue volatility
Unclear boundaries lead to unprofitable projects

alternativeModels: SaaS tool + consulting (build software for the problem)
